scope: Reviewed manual file removal in space browser and CLI

nativeCLI.scenario: CLI selected path replaced while confirmation prompt waits

behavior: Selection token binds selected entry metadata, deletion location and parent directory identity
CLI retains preview identity and measured sizes across confirmation instead of silently remeasuring a replacement
Execution rechecks open-file inventory and current whitelist for each path before final identity check
Unknown process-open inventory or missing/mismatched selection token cannot authorize a move
Repeated paths are deduplicated; partial moves retain readable Trash batch and incomplete-size marker
Space model holds quit lease until confirmed removal worker returns and rejects duplicate work/selection edits
Old duplicate scan result is invalidated before removal
limits: Metadata token does not seal recursive directory contents or eliminate final check/use races
OpenFiles kernel visibility is best effort; unavailable per-process details are not a full proof that no program uses the item
Ordinary quit is blocked; force quit, crashes and power loss are not covered
No new visible-window Space removal acceptance; model guard and real CLI prompt race were verified
Duplicate worker physical resource cap and SpaceTree cache invalidation need separate audits
No user files moved, native Trash modified, root query, helper installation, hardware writes or release
build: passed as part of full regression
